texts: End-stage anthracycline cardiomyopathy with an ejection fraction of 18%, a dilated ventricle and severe functional mitral regurgitation keeps her coming back despite optimal therapy.
The next step is evaluation for a left ventricular assist device or a heart transplant.
She has been free of cancer for eight years, which allows transplant listing, and an LVAD can serve as a bridge or as destination therapy.
With a narrow QRS of 95 ms, cardiac resynchronisation offers no benefit.
Her mitral regurgitation comes from the dilated ventricle, so fixing the valve alone does not change the course of the disease, and normal coronary arteries leave nothing to revascularise.
In the picture, Darth Vader and the gardener with the flowerpot heart wait at the door while Chopper waves the drummers away.
Memory hook: a ruby-stained accordion: Vader or a new heart.
